items.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act to Enforce New Reporting Requirements
items.description: Starting Friday, businesses operating in the EU will have just 24 hours to notify the government any time they discover serious product security incidents.

items.title: Trezor warns users of email provider breach, phishing attacks
items.description: Trezor warned customers on Wednesday that threat actors who breached its third-party email provider are targeting them in phishing attacks. [...]

items.title: Fortinet Code Execution Flaw Exploited in PivotC2 RAT Attacks
items.description: The high-severity, unauthenticated vulnerability tracked as CVE-2025-25249 was patched in January 2026. The post Fortinet Code Execution Flaw Exploited in PivotC2 RAT Attacks appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Cisco confirms CVE-2026-20079 Secure FMC flaw exploited in attacks
items.description: Cisco has confirmed that a maximum-severity authentication bypass vulnerability tracked as CVE-2026-20079 in its Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) software is being actively exploited in attacks. [...]

items.title: AdaptHealth confirms 4.1 million people exposed in July cyberattack
items.description: Healthcare company AdaptHealth has confirmed that data of 4.1 million people was exposed in a cyberattack discovered in July that was attributed to the ShinyHunters threat group. [...]

items.title: Mythos Vulnerability Firehose Hits a Human Bottleneck
items.description: An analysis of Project Glasswing findings shows only a fraction have reached disclosure, and an even smaller number have been fixed.

items.title: Skullcandy Dime 3 earbuds expose users to Bluetooth hijacking
items.description: The Carnegie Mellon University CERT Coordination Center (CERT/CC) is warning that Skullcandy Dime 3 wireless earbuds accept Bluetooth pairing requests from nearby unpaired devices without requiring user interaction. [...]

items.title: US Government Accuses Chinese AI Firms of Distilling Frontier Models
items.description: US agencies claim Chinese companies covertly extracted billions of tokens from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, and SpaceX's Grok to reduce development costs.

items.title: U.S. Disrupts Xinbi Guarantee Scam Marketplace, Freezes $52.8 Million in Crypto
items.description: The U.S. Department of Justice (DoJ) on Wednesday announced coordinated actions aimed at an illicit online marketplace called Xinbi Guarantee that offered scam services, including seizing Telegram channels used to run the service, confiscating two cryptocurrency wallets, and deploying the Scam Center Strike Force to Madagascar to help disrupt 13 scam compounds run by Chinese organized crime

items.title: HelmGuard Raises $7.3 Million for Agentic GRC and Security
items.description: The company will increase its US market presence and will expand its engineering and go-to-market teams. The post HelmGuard Raises $7.3 Million for Agentic GRC and Security appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: AI Is Giving Lesser-Resourced Attackers Nation-State-Level Reach, Google Warns
items.description: Criminal and state-sponsored adversaries are increasingly using AI to automate and scale their attacks, according to GTIG. The post AI Is Giving Lesser-Resourced Attackers Nation-State-Level Reach, Google Warns appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: US says Chinese firms extracted billions of tokens from frontier AI models
items.description: U.S. cybersecurity and intelligence agencies say that six Chinese AI companies conducted industrial-scale distillation attacks on American frontier AI models since at least late 2024. [...]

items.title: Four Spy Groups Used the Same Chrome and Windows Exploit Kit Within a Week
items.description: Multiple espionage-motivated threat activity clusters have been found deploying a previously undocumented exploit kit called BlueMoon that chains together multiple vulnerabilities in Microsoft Windows and Google Chrome. items.title: Android’s September 2026 Updates Patch 180 Vulnerabilities
items.description: The security updates resolve critical flaws across Android’s Framework, System, and Kernel components. The post Android’s September 2026 Updates Patch 180 Vulnerabilities appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Chipmaker Patch Tuesday: Nvidia, AMD, Arm Issue Security Advisories
items.description: Major chipmakers announced patches for vulnerabilities recently discovered in their products. The post Chipmaker Patch Tuesday: Nvidia, AMD, Arm Issue Security Advisories appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: Identity-Based AI Attack Threatens Security of Enterprise Data
items.description: "Workflow identity hijacking" can bypass standard security controls and hijack an organization's data by sending a basic request through an unauthenticated entry point.

items.title: Infostealer Logs Expose Replayable AI Tokens That Can Bypass MFA
items.description: Cybercriminals are hijacking artificial intelligence (AI) user accounts via information stealer logs to create "stolen keys" that grant illicit access to tools from model providers like Google, Anthropic, and others. items.title: Webinar: Learn How to Answer “Are We Exposed?” Faster After a New CVE
items.description: A major vulnerability is disclosed. The alert lands immediately. Then comes the harder question: Are we actually exposed? For many security teams, answering that means jumping between vulnerability scanners, endpoint tools, cloud inventories, SBOMs, repositories, and application data to build enough context to act. As AI accelerates vulnerability discovery and research, that delay matters more

items.title: DeepSeek Harness Flaw Let AI Agents Disable Their Own File Sandbox Without Approval
items.description: A flaw in DeepSeek Harness, DeepSeek's open-source tool for running AI coding agents on a developer's machine, let a sandboxed agent turn off its own sandbox with a single command. The tool runs an agent's commands inside an operating-system sandbox, so that an agent working on untrusted files cannot write outside its workspace. items.description: Over 130 companies tangled in sprawling phishing campaign that spoofed a multi-factor authentication system.

items.description: Lockbit is by far this summer’s most prolific ransomware group, trailed by two offshoots of the Conti group.
